files.content:
# Pixel Dice Poker

A small offline dice poker game made with HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript. No server, packages, network access, or external assets are needed.

## Play

Open `index.html` in a modern browser. Click **Roll dice** to roll the five dice. Click any die to hold or release it, then roll again. You have two rerolls per round; the hand name appears after the second reroll. Select dice with a mouse, or use Tab and Enter/Space from the keyboard. Choose **New round** to begin again.

Hands are reported as five of a kind, four of a kind, full house, straight, three of a kind, two pair, pair, or no pair.
